# `assets/humanoid/HandRig.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/humanoid/HandRig.js`

engine/assets/humanoid/HandRig.js — hand + finger rig schema (spec §12). A hand is a wrist + up to five fingers, each a short bone chain. Fingers come from one of three sources: the source skeleton's named bones (`skeleton`), procedurally GENERATED from the hand mesh when the skeleton has none (`generated`), or a single paddle bone when the hand is a closed fist / too low-poly (`paddle`).
